title: Logarithmic-space word-size computation
statement: For every natural number $c$, there is a natural number $a$ and a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet such that, on every Boolean input $x$ of length $n$, the machine outputs the binary bits of $c(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)$ within at most $a(n+1)$ steps and uses at most $a(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)$ work-tape cells.
